content: next-intl 4.13.6 is current stable. Supports Next.js 12-16 and React 16.8-19. Setup: defineRouting() in i18n/routing.ts declares locales=['en','de'] and defaultLocale='de'. proxy.ts (formerly middleware.ts in Next.js 16) uses createMiddleware(routing). App directory uses app/[locale]/ segment. createNavigation exports locale-aware Link, redirect, usePathname, useRouter. hreflang is generated via getPathname() called per locale. Locale detection priority: pathname prefix > cookie > Accept-Language header > defaultLocale.
